21.stem:
The criteria for selecting a Mechanical Engineer are:
1. M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering with more than 75% marks.
2. More than 65% in the written test and more than 70% in the interview.
3. Age in completed years between 30 and 35 (inclusive) on 1 January 2019.

27.stem:
Which measures were central to India’s New Industrial Policy, 1991?
I. Foreign investment rules and industrial licensing were liberalised.
II. A uniform mandatory exit arrangement for sick private-sector industrial units was introduced across all industries.
27.review: Removed an artificially extreme distractor that made the answer obvious. Statement II now tests a specific policy claim; check the accompanying note when reviewing. The main liberalisation measures included easing industrial licensing and foreign-investment controls.

39.stem:

44.stem:
Consider the Five-Year Plans:
I. The Sixth Five-Year Plan (1980–85) included poverty reduction, employment and technological modernisation objectives.
II. The Third Five-Year Plan (1961–66) was disrupted by wars and successive droughts.
Which statement(s) are correct?
44.review: The Third Plan was derailed principally by wars and severe drought; the 1966 rupee devaluation occurred after its scheduled period. Statement II needs clearer framing.

45.stem:
Consider the 2026 Asian U-19 and U-23 Boxing Championships held in Jakarta.
1. Indian women won five gold medals across U-19 and U-23 competitions.
2. The competition ran from 3 to 16 July 2026.
3. Two Indian boxers won gold in the men’s U-23 finals.
4. Uzbekistan secured 33 medals, including 21 gold medals.
Which of these statements is/are correct?
45.review: Original statement 3 undercounted women’s golds. Replaced unsupported overall tally with independently corroborated event results.
45.explanation: Women: five gold across U19/U23 (DD India). Men: Vishvanath Suresh and Ganga won U23 gold. Asian Boxing lists 3–16 July; Uzbekistan secured 33 medals including 21 gold.

51.stem: A right square pyramid has a square base of side 10 cm. The length of each slant edge from apex to a base vertex is 13 cm. Find the vertical height.
51.review: “Slant height along the diagonal (face diagonal)” is not a standard unambiguous pyramid measurement. Using the slant edge (apex to square-base vertex) gives vertical height √119≈10.9 cm.
51.explanation: “Slant height along the diagonal (face diagonal)” is not a standard unambiguous pyramid measurement. Using the slant edge (apex to square-base vertex) gives vertical height √119≈10.9 cm.

66.stem: Two tangents QP and QR from external point Q touch a circle at P and R. If QP = QR = 40 cm and the angle PQR = 60°, find the perimeter of triangle PQR.
66.review: OQ = 41 cm, radius 9 cm and ∠PQR = 60° are inconsistent: the radius implied by the angle is 20.5 cm. For the revised version, the radius is 20.5 cm, giving an equilateral triangle PQR with 35.51 cm sides, not in the options; instead the geometry is made compatible with the 120 cm choice.
